items.title: Return signed participation form
items.quote: Please return the signed participation form by 07/08/2026.
items.computation: The letter is written in English but comes from a German institute (Science Park 2, 69117 Beispielberg) addressed to a recipient in Berlin, and the earlier date on the same letter (05/05/2026, i.e. its own document date of 5 May 2026) is consistent with the European day/month/year convention. Reading 07/08/2026 the same way (DD/MM/YYYY) gives 7 August 2026. The letter states the form must be received by this date ('Forms received after this date cannot be considered'), so the deadline is the day the signed form must arrive at the institute, not merely be sent.
